title: 第106章 拯救人质
content_zh:
这个形态不同于冲击的纯粹暴力，也不同于涌动形态的灵活操控，而是直接操控重力。

李艾可以根据需要微调重力朝向，他只要在身体周围布下一层重力场，就能隔绝大部分伤害。

所以李艾才会说对方的攻击还差一点才能打到他。

不过马莱基也是身经百战的斯库鲁战士，不会轻易认输。

“哼，像你这

另一种就是哪怕以如今第九级体质的能量转换速度外加第七级的【天人合一】都不够应验这个誓言。

“姚东家，我很意外你会找上我，不过还是很感谢你，我已经另有打算了。”苏念委婉拒绝了。

即使是自己，曾经动过让弟弟进入忽儿博府的念头。自己都不能原谅自己，更何况是别人？

“没事，没事！没撞疼你吧？”袁三爷一点都没生气，而是一边花痴般的看着狗剩，一边上下其手。

听传言，宫月影应该在是土系九级左右，她要契约的，必然也只在统领级，多臣相最近新破君主三级，对付一只魔兽还是没问题的。

兰奉天的气恼并非多虑，事实上，就在这一刻宫里宫外已经传遍了，以往倍受尊敬的国师大人俨然已经成为最大的笑柄。

负责人兼驾驶员率先跳出舱，随手拿麻布擦了把脸和头发，就开始利索地搬弄垫脚凳。

走到营帐门口，他突然回头对众人笑了一下，笑得有些说不出来的古怪。

沐聪心里一愣，怎么皇帝会突然问出这个问题来？楚时琨和皇帝是老相识了，他应该了解的要比我清楚，为什么反而来问我？

“大姐是当心撑到你了，你个贪吃鬼，饿死鬼投胎呢，吃那么多还吃不饱，我都担心你肚子给撑出个好歹来！”沈敏瞪眼道。

当那两人仓皇之间出手，又怎么可能挡得住古云的全力出手，所以相继死鱼古云的手中。人死了，古云自然不会放过自己的战利品，那挂在他们腰间的乾坤袋便是他的战利品了。

“你看我们的柳青恢复得多好！二十天前我在县人民医院看见你昏迷不醒的样子真是让我揪心难过。”林红艳拍了拍柳青的胳膊说。

“这里还要谢谢刘智老师的提醒，谢谢你，刘老师。”月红把手搭在刘智肩上，朝转过头的刘智莞尔一笑。

面对他深情的表白，顾萌只是移开了眼，没有说话。他害得自己与家人爱人分离，就算是再深的爱，也无法撼动她的心。

这几天的时间铭南心中也明白雨露有着情绪，可是他不知道应该要如何的让雨露发泄出来，导致了他心中也难受着。

“我，我答应你还不行吗？”我的心在滴血，我只能委屈地答应了，我泪眼模糊地上了床，侧着身子背对着这个无情无义的冷血动物，任凭泪水在我的脸颊肆意地奔流，浸湿了枕头。

连绒满脸通红，点点头，看着他弯腰坐入驾驶座内，看着他发动车子，将车开出去，连绒一路跟着，知道他的车子消失在别墅区内，这才转身进门去。

庄洪天苦笑道：“上一次的事情吓到你了吗，我也很抱歉，我并不想伤害你，只是有时候，我会控制不了我的第二人格，你知道——”他说完，指了指脑子。

如果白兰这时稍有退缩之意，那么她袭击狼王的力量就会削弱，狼王会趁机摆脱漫天的雪花袭击并一口气杀了白兰。
content_en:
This form is different from the pure violence of impact, and different from the flexible control of surge form, but direct manipulation of gravity.

Li Ai can fine-tune the direction of gravity as needed. As long as he lays a layer of gravity field around his body, he can isolate most damage.

That's why Li Ai said that the opponent's attack was still a little short of hitting him.

However, Maleki is also a battle-hardened Skrull warrior and will not give in easily.

The other is that even the energy conversion speed of the current ninth-level physique plus the seventh-level [Unity of Heaven and Man] is not enough to fulfill this oath.

"Yao Dongjia, I'm surprised that you came to me, but I'm still very grateful to you. I already have other plans."Su Nian declined politely.

Even I had once considered letting my younger brother enter the Huerbo Mansion.You can't forgive yourself, let alone others?

"It's okay, it's okay!Didn't it hurt you?"Yuan Sanye was not angry at all, but looked at Gou Sheng like an idiot while raising and lowering his hands.

According to rumors, Gong Yueying should be around the ninth level of the earth element. The one she wants to contract must only be at the commander level. Many ministers have recently broken through the third level of the monarch, so it is no problem to deal with a monster.

Lan Fengtian's anger was not unfounded. In fact, at this moment, word had spread throughout the palace and outside the palace, and the revered Imperial Master in the past had become the biggest laughing stock.

The person in charge and driver jumped out of the cabin first, wiped his face and hair with a linen cloth, and began to move the step stool neatly.

When he reached the door of the camp, he suddenly turned around and smiled at everyone, his smile was a little weird.

Mu Cong was stunned, why would the emperor suddenly ask this question?Chu Shikun and the emperor were old acquaintances. He should know better than me. Why did he come to ask me instead?

"Sister, be careful of overstuffing you. You are a glutton. You are reincarnated as a starving ghost. You are still not full after eating so much. I am worried that your stomach will burst out!Shen Min glared.

When those two people took action in a hurry, how could they possibly block Gu Yun's full attack, so they died one after another in Gu Yun's hands.When people die, Gu Yun will naturally not let go of his trophies. The Qiankun bag hanging on their waist is his trophy.

"Look how well our Liu Qing has recovered!Twenty days ago, I saw you unconscious in the County People's Hospital, which really made me heartbroken." Lin Hongyan patted Liu Qing's arm and said.

"I would also like to thank Teacher Liu Zhi for the reminder. Thank you, Teacher Liu."Yue Hong put her hand on Liu Zhi's shoulder and smiled at Liu Zhi who turned his head.

Faced with his affectionate confession, Gu Meng just looked away and said nothing.He caused her to be separated from her family and loved ones. Even the deepest love could not shake her heart.

In the past few days, Mingnan also understood that Yulu had emotions, but he didn't know how to let Yulu vent them, which made him feel uncomfortable.

"I, can't I promise you?"My heart was bleeding, and I could only agree aggrievedly. I got on the bed with blurred eyes and turned my back to this ruthless, cold-blooded animal. I let the tears flow freely on my cheeks and soaked the pillow.

Lian Rong's face turned red and he nodded, watching him bend down and sit in the driver's seat. He watched him start the car and drive out. Lian Rong followed him all the way. When his car disappeared into the villa area, he turned around and went in.

Zhuang Hongtian smiled bitterly and said: "Did what happened last time scare you? I'm sorry too. I don't want to hurt you, but sometimes, I can't control my second personality. You know-" After he finished speaking, he pointed to his brain.

If Bai Lan flinches a little at this time, her power to attack the Wolf King will be weakened, and the Wolf King will take the opportunity to get rid of the snowflakes in the sky and kill Bai Lan in one go.
